generate_data_nschools: generate synthetic train and test datasets for the n-schools hierarchical model with configurable parameters
evaluate_posterior_predictive: compute the predictive likelihood of test items against posterior samples from an n-schools model
test_eight_schools_e2e: test the eight schools model end-to-end by building a probabilistic graph and running NMC inference
build_probabilistic_graph: build a probabilistic program graph using beanmachine graph API with distributions, samples, queries, and observations
infer_mean_nmc: infer the mean of queried random variables using the NMC inference algorithm on a probabilistic graph
